notes: This registry governs whether ACK2007 model inputs may be constructed from raw data.
It does not validate arbitrary raw-source columns and it does not replace frozen synthetic compiler fixtures.
Preconstructed-input compatibility remains a separate scientific admission decision.

SEGMENTS.reason: Exact fiscal timing must be locked before raw construction.

FOREIGN_SALES.definition: 1 if firm reports foreign sales; 0 otherwise
FOREIGN_SALES.reason: Recovered source definition is marked PASS in ACK2007 Phase 4.

M&A.definition: Merger/acquisition activity indicator as defined by the paper

RESTRUCTURE.definition: Restructuring activity/charge indicator as defined by the paper

RGROWTH.definition: Decile rank of average sales growth rate, 2002-2004
RGROWTH.reason: Missing-data and ranking eligibility rule remains unresolved.

SIZE.definition: Average market value of equity over 2001-2003, USD billions

%LOSS.definition: Proportion of years 2001-2003 with negative earnings
%LOSS.reason: Recovered source definition is marked PASS in ACK2007 Phase 4.

RZSCORE.definition: Decile rank of Altman (1980) z-score/distress measure
RZSCORE.reason: Exact raw formula inputs, missing-data policy, and decile reference implementation remain unresolved.
